dht.evidence: The blue DHT11 sensor with a grid is visible on the breadboard near the top left.

lcd.evidence: The LCD 1602 screen with the I2C module is visible at the bottom of the image.

found: GND wire connected to I2C module
VCC wire connected to I2C module

lcd_wires.evidence: Four wires are connected to the I2C module pins on the back of the LCD.

dht_data.evidence: The signal wire from the DHT11 (second pin) goes to the breadboard and then to digital pin 2 on the Arduino.

sda.evidence: The SDA wire from the I2C module connects to the A4 pin on the Arduino.

scl.evidence: The SCL wire from the I2C module connects to the A5 pin on the Arduino.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The GND wire from the Arduino connects to the negative rail on the breadboard.
